name: Transfer
description: A title for a student who transferred in. Equip it and you get priority invitations in the lobby.

name: Freshman
description: A title for a student who has only just enrolled. The penalty for fainting is waived.

name: Repeater
description: A title for a student who falls behind in their studies through lack of effort.

name: Fail King
description: A title given to a student who fails a year over and over.

name: Runaway
description: A title given to a student who bolts the moment things stop going their way.

name: Easygoing
description: A title given to a student who takes it slow instead of studying hard.
condition: Spend a long time without playing an episode

name: Milk Fiend
condition: Drink a great deal more milk

name: Milk Demon
description: Milk restores you very much faster.
condition: Drink milk in truly excessive quantities

name: No Absence
description: A bonus is added to your score when you clear an episode.
condition: Come to school every single day

name: Guma Bane
description: The Warguma live in fear of you.

name: Exorcist
description: An expert in dealing with ghosts.

name: Tycoon
description: Has the effect of making you look rich.
condition: Collect a great deal of money

name: Gold Buyer
description: You receive gold member service when buying and selling at the shop.
condition: Buy a lot at the shop

name: Fox Sage
description: The one who knows most about the affairs of the fox cave.

name: Speed King
description: A bonus is added to your EXP when you clear an episode.

name: Zombie
condition: Clear episodes while unconscious, over and over

name: Anna Fan
description: Certified as a fan (slave?) of SD Anna.

name: Coward
description: A title given to a student who ran away in the middle of a competitive episode.
condition: Abandon a competitive episode partway through

name: Deadman
description: A dishonourable title given to a user who disconnects from the game improperly.
